item.title: MacKenzie Scott gave $30m to housing nonprofit; a year later, it unveiled 10-year plan
item.description: In October 2024, MacKenzie Scott made headlines by donating $30 million to Housing Trust Silicon Valley via her Yield Giving fund. This substantial contribution will support various housing initiatives over the next decade, particularly focusing on enhancing homeownership assistance. Housing Trust has a successful track record, having already developed thousands of affordable homes in the Bay Area.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Mississippi couple wins $41,920 after loggers cut 1,299 trees on their land
item.description: In a significant logging error, 1,299 trees were cut down on Gerald and Rhonda Smith's property in Mississippi. The Smiths meticulously recorded the extent of their loss through photographs and measurements, leading to legal proceedings. A court recognized the logging company's blatant negligence, awarding the couple $41,920. Expert surveyor J.T. Strickland confirmed the boundary lines, and the appeals court reaffirmed the lower court’s ruling, validating the Smiths' claims for damages.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Father got 3 bigha in 1972; HC protects married daughter's land claim
item.description: In 1972, the Himachal Pradesh government allotted three bigha and two biswas of agricultural land in Shimla to a person under the Nautor rules for cultivation. His wife died in 2012, leaving behind their only daughter, who subsequently approached the revenue authorities once again for issuance of the patta. Her request was reportedly rejected outright on the ground that married daughters were ineligible for land under the Nautor rules.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: Warring out, Pargat in: Has Congress solved Punjab crisis or set stage for another twist?
item.description: Amarinder Singh Raja Warring has resigned as the president of the Punjab Congress after more than four years. His resignation follows a prolonged period of infighting over leadership roles within the party. Both Charanjit Singh Channi and Warring have seen shifts in their status amid ongoing power struggles. But has Congress really solved the Punjab crisis?
item.dc:creator: PRIYANKA MUKHERJEE

item.title: Iowa farmer gave 2 acres to wind turbines; lease became farm’s most profitable part
item.description: In Iowa, a farmer discovered that collaborating with wind turbine projects resulted in a steadier income stream than conventional farming. This innovative approach combats the unpredictability of commodity prices and rising operational expenses. Numerous Midwestern farmers embrace this strategy, leading to sustainable financial growth. Wind energy initiatives also bolster local economies via enhanced tax revenues and infrastructure upgrades, demonstrating resilience despite some community pushback.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Wyoming ranch sat unsold 14 months; buyer appeared before no-reserve auction
item.description: A 558-acre Wyoming ranch sat unsold for 14 months despite a price cut from nearly $20 million to $15 million. When the owner planned a no-reserve auction, about 40 prospective bidders visited the property in 36 days, prompting one buyer to make an offer before the auction began.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Six years after his $10 billion climate pledge, Jeff Bezos turns to the Pacific Ocean
item.description: Jeff Bezos’ Earth Fund has announced more than $25 million in new ocean conservation grants across five Pacific nations. The funding will support marine protection and sustainable management across more than 625,000 square miles. The latest awards bring the fund’s Pacific commitment to $63.3 million of its planned $100 million.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: London rail soil helped rebuild Essex wetlands; reserve later saw 39,000 birds
item.description: More than three million tonnes of soil excavated for London’s Elizabeth line were transported to Wallasea Island in Essex to help create coastal wetlands. Ten years after seawalls were breached, the restored RSPB reserve has recorded a record 39,000 wintering birds, including thousands of Knot, Avocets, Grey Plovers and Bar-tailed Godwits.

item.title: How Freddie Freeman's family shaped the Dodgers star's MLB journey
item.description: Freddie Freeman’s family has been with him on his baseball journey. His childhood was marked by the loss of his mother, Rosemary and father, Fred, who helped develop his swing. Years later, Freddie and Chelsea Freeman faced a serious health crisis when their son Maximus developed Guillain-Barré syndrome. His return preceded Freeman’s historic 2024 World Series performance and $1 million donation to CHOC.

item.description: Jey Uso's net worth is projected to be between four to five million dollars in 2026. Jimmy Uso's estimated fortune ranges between two to four million dollars during the same time period. Solo Sikoa's net worth is forecasted to be around three million dollars in 2026. Their earnings primarily come from WWE salaries and merchandise royalties associated with their wrestling careers.

item.title: Ohio man allegedly took $3m from investors for fake ticket scheme
item.description: An Ohio man pleaded guilty to running a fake investment scheme that prosecutors say defrauded five victims in Ohio and Florida of more than $3 million. John E. Brown II promoted supposed “rolling code ticket packages” linked to sports and theme-park experiences, but the investment did not exist. Prosecutors said he used investors’ money for personal expenses, including about $1.375 million in casino transfers.

item.title: Ohio farmer with $1m medical debt sold land after officials blocked solar lease
item.description: In Ohio, farmer Wayne Greier's financial struggles intensified when a planned solar project fell through due to local resistance and new rules, leaving his family's renewable energy plans in jeopardy. Compounded by $1 million in medical debt from recent health issues, Greier was forced to offload land and equipment, jeopardizing his farming business. He has emerged as an advocate for farmers' property rights to help protect others from similar hardships.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: From papads to pitches: NCERT brings startup lessons to Class IX
item.description: A new chapter on startups and entrepreneurship has been introduced for Class IX students in NCERT textbooks. The chapter emphasizes the growth of India's startup ecosystem over the past decade. It includes important lessons on identifying business opportunities and creating effective business plans. Entrepreneurial stories, including those of Lijjat Papad and Mohan Singh Oberoi, illustrate key concepts.

item.title: Akhilesh's Rajya Sabha picks: SP's master strategy or 'PDA' contradiction?
item.description: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav's Rajya Sabha picks, including uncle Ram Gopal Yadav and Reliance executive Dhanraj Parimal Nathwani, are being seen as an early test for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly polls. The nominations raise questions over the SP's PDA strategy, its broader political outreach and a possible third Rajya Sabha candidate, despite the party's numbers falling short of the winning quota.
item.dc:creator: PALLAVI

item.title: Kevin O’Leary-backed Utah AI data center plan downsized after local backlash
item.description: Kevin O’Leary-backed plans for a 40,000-acre AI data centre district in Utah have been cut to about 20,000 acres after strong local opposition. Residents have raised concerns over the project’s energy and water use, environmental impact and public review. Developers say the project could create thousands of jobs and support US computing and national defence.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: AI and the monk: Anthropic goes for swami and friends to tame Claude
item.description: Anthropic engaged various religious scholars and philosophers to explore ethical frameworks for advanced AI development. The discussions included considerations about potential moral status and consciousness in AI like Claude. Participants included Swami Sarvapriyananda, who has addressed the distinctions between intelligence and consciousness. The aim is to incorporate values from multiple faith traditions into AI training processes.
item.dc:creator: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA

item.description: The ACC confirmed that Naqvi will miss the final at Korogi Park because of "prior commitments". India and Pakistan will meet for the gold medal after Sri Lanka and Bangladesh play the bronze-medal match.

item.title: SIR under review: Former SC, HC judges to examine 'validity' of voter roll revision
item.description: A panel of five former judges is being formed to review the Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision. The Lawyers Association for Constitution emphasizes the panel's independence in assessing the review's validity and impact. Senior lawyers are expected to provide strategic legal advice to the panel throughout the process. The Election Commission has also initiated a drive to identify and re-enrol excluded eligible voters.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: Assam nightclub horror: Woman stripped, kicked on floor; manager detained
item.description: A woman was allegedly stripped and assaulted in a nightclub located in Khanapara, Guwahati. The incident reportedly involved bouncers, and videos show the woman's distressing situation. The nightclub's manager has been detained for questioning following the event. Police officials confirmed that they will take legal action after investigating the case. The identity of the victim remains unknown as authorities continue to gather information.

item.title: Israeli investigators to question Omani co-pilot in UAE-led flydubai probe: Report
item.description: Israeli investigators are expected to question the Omani co-pilot involved in the flight attack incident. The investigation is led by UAE authorities to determine the motives and background of the co-pilot. The attack occurred during flydubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv, resulting in an emergency landing. The Indian captain was stabbed but managed to regain control and land safely.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Rahul demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation as protests erupt in Delhi, Mumbai
item.description: Rahul Gandhi has called for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation during ongoing protests. These protests arose over allegations of irregularities in the electoral-roll revision exercise. Approximately 700 protesters were detained in Delhi while trying to gather near Jantar Mantar for the demonstrations. Additional protests took place in Mumbai, where various groups demanded Kumar's resignation and accountability.
